LanguageData.SS_LimitedAwarenessDesc: You know what your colonists know. Threats are discovered through surveillance systems or lookouts. Immersive and challenging.
LanguageData.SS_AreaOmniscienceDesc: You know more than your colonists. All local information is easily found, and events are omnisciently conveyed to you. The classic experience.
LanguageData.SS_UseWalkieDesc: Radio a colonist who is carrying a walkie talkie and see through their eyes. The camera follows them until you stop.
LanguageData.SS_NoWalkieContacts: No other colonists are carrying a walkie talkie.
LanguageData.SS_BlowSignalHornDesc: Blow the signal horn to alert the entire colony to danger.
LanguageData.SS_HostileSpottedDesc: {0} has reported spotting a hostile ({1}) over the radio.
LanguageData.SS_HostileSpottedInPersonDesc: {0} has reported spotting a hostile ({1}) in person.
LanguageData.SS_AccessFeedsRemoteDesc: Connect to a local surveillance router to view camera feeds remotely.
LanguageData.SS_NoSurveillanceRouter: No operational surveillance router found on the network.
LanguageData.SS_DeviceNotLinked: This device has not been linked to a router. Select this colonist and right-click a router to link it.
LanguageData.SS_LinkedRouterOffline: The linked surveillance router is offline.
LanguageData.SS_AbortMonitoringDesc: Stop monitoring the surveillance feeds through the linked router.
LanguageData.SS_HideColonistBar: Hide colonist bar in authentic mode
LanguageData.SS_HideColonistBarDesc: While limited awareness is active in authentic mode, hide the colonist bar and its toggle button in the play settings.
LanguageData.SS_LinkAlarmBuildingDesc: Link this alarm trigger to electric lights, power switches, or loudspeakers.
LanguageData.SS_RadarOffline: Colony radar is unpowered or missing. Minimap offline.
LanguageData.SS_FriendlyScoutsDialogIntro: A diplomatic scout from {0} named {1} has arrived to verify relations and reports of colony conduct.
LanguageData.SS_ProvideTruth: Provide truth on colony actions (+10 goodwill, apply debts)
LanguageData.SS_LieToScouts: Conceal wrongdoing and lie ({0} success chance)
LanguageData.SS_ScoutsIgnored: Diplomatic scouts from {0} were ignored and reported negative conduct.
LanguageData.SS_EnemyScoutsFinished: Enemy scouts from {0} have finished reconnaissance and escaped with intelligence.
LanguageData.SS_LetterFriendlyScoutsText: A scouting party from {0} has arrived to check on colony conduct and relations. A negotiator can provide them with intelligence.
LanguageData.SS_LetterEnemyScoutsText: Scouts from {0} have arrived at the edge of your settlement to observe your colony's prosperity and potential unwanted activity. They will observe for a while then leave. They can be intercepted, but be warned that this can cause retaliation.
LanguageData.SS_LetterRetaliationText: After their previous scouting party failed, {0} has sent another larger scouting party determined to discern the ongoings of this settlement.
LanguageData.SS_ScoutsTruthProvided: Provided intelligence to diplomatic scouts from {0}.
LanguageData.SS_ScoutsLieCaught: Diplomatic scouts from {0} discovered your deception.
LanguageData.SS_LimitViewingMaps: Limit viewing maps while player character is not present
LanguageData.SS_AnnounceVisits: Announce visits/raids regardless of awareness setting
LanguageData.SS_EnableAlertInDirector: Enable alert system while in director mode
LanguageData.SS_RelationsLiePenalty: Relations hit on being caught lying
LanguageData.SS_RelationsIgnorePenalty: Relations hit on ignoring sharing information
LanguageData.SS_FogViewDistance: View distance for fog of war
LanguageData.SS_GuardDutyDesc: Assign this pawn to stand at a guard spot, walk a patrol route, or protect a colonist. Guards engage hostiles that come near their duty and return to it afterward.
LanguageData.SS_GuardDutyTooltip: Guard duty: {0}\nClick to change where this pawn serves.
LanguageData.SS_StanceHoldDesc: Stay close to the duty and only fight hostiles within {0} tiles of it.
LanguageData.SS_StanceDefendDesc: Fight hostiles within {0} tiles of the duty, then return.
LanguageData.SS_StancePursueDesc: Chase hostiles up to {0} tiles away from the duty before returning.
LanguageData.SS_DutyColumnTip: Click to change where this guard serves.
LanguageData.SS_RenamePostDesc: Give this guard spot a name.
LanguageData.SS_AssignGuardToPostDesc: Choose who stands guard at this spot. A spot holds up to {0} guards.
LanguageData.SS_NoEligibleGuards: No pawns can guard right now
LanguageData.SS_WaypointRouteDesc: Move the selected waypoints to another route, or start a new one.
LanguageData.SS_RenameRouteDesc: Give this patrol route a name.
LanguageData.SS_WaypointEarlierDesc: Move this waypoint one step earlier in the route.
LanguageData.SS_WaypointLaterDesc: Move this waypoint one step later in the route.
LanguageData.SS_WaypointDwellDesc: How long a patrolling guard waits at this waypoint before moving on. Click to cycle.
LanguageData.SS_RouteModeDesc: Loop returns from the last waypoint to the first. Back and forth walks the route in reverse. Click to switch.
LanguageData.SS_SelectRouteDesc: Select every waypoint on this route.
LanguageData.SS_KeepWatchDesc: Whether this animal carries out its guard duty. Turn off to pause it without losing the assignment.
LanguageData.SS_AlertResponseTooltip: Alert response: {0}\nClick to change how this animal reacts when it spots a hostile.
LanguageData.SS_AlertResponseDesc: How this animal reacts when spotting a hostile.
LanguageData.SS_NoAlarmTriggerFound: {0} could not find an operational alarm trigger to push.
LanguageData.SS_AlreadyLinkedToTablet: Already linked to an existing tablet
LanguageData.SS_UseBinocularsDesc: Raise the binoculars and scan the distance. The camera is freed to roam the map at any range, but you will only see a small circle around it, and only where this pawn has a clear line of sight.
LanguageData.SS_StopUsingBinocularsDesc: Stop looking through the binoculars and return to normal view.
LanguageData.SS_BinocularsNeedsLimitedAwareness: Binoculars only do something under limited awareness.
LanguageData.SS_UseTelescopeDesc: Peer through the spyglass. The camera is freed to roam the map at any range, but you will only see a tight pinhole around it, and only where this pawn has a clear line of sight.
LanguageData.SS_StopUsingTelescopeDesc: Stop looking through the spyglass and return to normal view.
LanguageData.SS_TelescopeNeedsLimitedAwareness: Spyglass only does something under limited awareness.
